steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Small dice the celery and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl with the celery.
Add olive oil to the pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the celery and onion to the pan; cook, stirring frequently, until the vegetables have softened, 4 to 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
Slide the rosemary leaves off the sprigs; discard the sprigs and mince the leaves. Add to the garlic.
Add the garlic, rosemary, and crushed red pepper to the pan; stir and cook until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and their liquid to the pan, followed by the tomatoes and broth; stir to combine.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper, then break apart some of the tomatoes and chickpeas with a potato masher or fork. Bring the sauce to a simmer.
Add the pasta directly to the sauté pan and mix with the sauce. Cook the pasta in the sauce according to package directions, about 8 to 12 minutes.
To serve, scoop the pasta into a bowl. Enjoy!
